text: Just went for our kid. The dentist was very nice and great. All the staff were also very friendly.

A friendly dentist with a smile and sense of humour! This certainly makes 'going to the dentist' a better experience. The staff were very attentive and thorough, always asking how I felt about the treatment.
I will return in the future to get new teeth!

I brought my girlfriend here to get a tooth extracted, and she said it would be better to get braces here too because it feels so welcoming. We've looked at many clinics, but this one feels the most comfortable. Please maintain this standard.
My favorite dentist in Phuket. I got all my teeth cleaned and whitened. The staff is professional and polite, and the prices are reasonable.

I had a broken filling and it was fixed at this clinic. Kind staff carefully did everything and explained what they were going to do to fix the problem. There were several obstacles with the problem tooth, but the doctor did everything perfectly. I visited this clinic immediately after facing the problem, and it didn’t require sedation or a painkiller injection - zero pain. Very thankful for the help. Highly qualified specialists.

The doctor was very gentle. The service was good and friendly.
The place was clean. Now I have a beautiful smile 😁 …

text: I just had a tooth extracted. The service was excellent. Everyone was very polite and helpful. The male dentist was very gentle. The assistant was kind enough to hold my hand to reduce my fear; it went from 100% to 50%! I'll be going back to see him for a filling once my wound has healed.

text: We used this dentist during our vacation in Phuket. My wife had a severe toothache. The place is very clean and hygienic, and the doctors and staff speak English. They took a picture and suggested either root canal treatment or tooth extraction. My wife opted for the extraction, which was quick and painless. She received a set of medications and instructions on how to continue taking care of herself. We recommend it.

I just had two teeth extracted and a teeth cleaning. The dentist was a man, very kind and had a very gentle touch. He made me want to see dentists more often; before this, I was very afraid of dentists.

The service is excellent! I've been here twice already. The dentist is lovely, gives great advice, and is extremely attentive. Most recently, I had a teeth cleaning and fillings done, and the dentist was incredibly meticulous and caring. I just had to recommend them to others! Thank you! 🙏 …

text: I was terrified of braces and anything related to teeth before, but I decided to come here because my teeth were getting worse. My fear was 100%, but meeting this doctor was amazing! They gave great advice and were very gentle. Thank you for reducing my fear! #Doctor

Excellent dentistry🙏🏻 Very caring and professional staff. I didn't even notice how the tooth was removed. The quality is above any price. By the way, the whole procedure cost 2200 baht. I am grateful to the doctor and all the staff of the clinic🙏🏻 …

Excellent service, very careful and diligent dentists, they take their time to do a perfect job. I have been using the services and treatments now for > 1 year and I was always satisfied. The whole team is just perfect. 👏🏻
PS. Since I used to only have treatments with Nr 1 hospitals or doctors in Austria (known for very high standards) - I think my judgement has some weight. & I love the oversized "Teddy" .. 🤣
Excellent clinic, very pleasant interior. I had a cleaning here; the doctors are attentive, everything is done carefully and efficiently. From now on, I'll always get my cleanings here in Phuket.
I visited the clinic twice and saw a male doctor both times. Both gave good advice. The first doctor was lovely, and the second was straightforward but sincere. I will definitely visit again.

text: The doctor is very kind. The price is the same as other clinics, but the service is excellent and very attentive to patients. The doctor speaks very politely. Thank you for your patience with the patient. I had a cracked molar, the innermost one, and it had previously undergone root canal treatment. Most of the tooth structure had fallen out, and I experienced nausea during the procedure. I've been to other clinics where the doctor scolded me for not being patient and cooperative, but this doctor understood. When I raised my hand, the doctor took a break and then continued. The doctor is very polite. I highly recommend this clinic. The nurses are also kind and explained things I didn't understand, even technical terms. I got the answers I needed. Excellent service mind. Highly recommend this clinic. 🙏🙏🙏🙏❤️❤️

I had a lower front tooth treated here in 2023. I had a small chip, and I bit into some cold chocolate. 🙈 The treatment cost 1,000 baht. It's been 1.5 years now, the filling is holding, and everything is fine. I went back today. I had deep decay in my lower 7th tooth, which was covered by an old filling, but not pulpitis. The treatment cost 1,700 baht, including X-rays. Perfect! Excellent value for money! I highly recommend them!!!
Not recommended.

Dr. Tak reduced my fear of going to the dentist by 50%! The other 50% is still scary 🤣
Dr. Tak is so lovely and incredibly patient. She carefully explained each step of the procedure and helped to relax my fear, relieving my stress like a yoga instructor 🤣. She also explained the aftercare and was so friendly. Of all the dentists I've ever been to in my life, Dr. Tak is the best. The clinic is clean and the staff are polite.
